critical_code_review_comments: bid-engine.js is 1531 lines — approaching maintainability threshold (>700). Consider splitting: (submit path, auth/cookie mgmt, scheduler, verification) into modules. Non-blocking for this iteration.

Post-save verification block is well-scoped: fire-and-forget, guarded, unref()-ed, catches its own errors. Semantics of the three log outcomes (OK / PARTIAL / FAILED) are clear and actionable for the user.
The `submitted=` relabel is applied consistently in both the console log line and the bidLog CSV row (rankMsg), so downstream CSV parsers won't see mixed labels.
